about.title: About & sources
about.intro: Voltway is a free, no-login site for EV drivers and shoppers: specs and charging curves where every figure shows where it came from, and a map of public chargers.
about.coverage: The vehicle list covers {market} today ({count} variants).
about.methodIntro: Every figure carries a badge that says what kind of figure it is. Open the badge to see the source, when it was read, and any other figures that sources give.
about.kind.rated_nrcan: An official rating from Natural Resources Canada.
about.kind.rated_epa: An official rating from the US EPA.
about.kind.rated_wltp: A rating on the European WLTP test cycle.
about.kind.manufacturer: Stated by the carmaker, or relayed by press or a dealer.
about.kind.tested: Measured in an independent test, such as a recorded charging session.
about.kind.community: Shared by owners, for example from charging logs.
about.kind.estimated: Worked out by Voltway when no source states it. Shown with "~" and an explanation.
about.kind.unknown: No source has this figure yet. It is shown as unknown rather than guessed.
about.precedence: When sources disagree, one figure is shown first. For range and energy use: official ratings from {regulator}, then US EPA ratings, carmaker figures, tests, community figures and estimates (WLTP only when nothing else exists). For specifications such as battery size and charging power: the carmaker's own page, then independent tests, then datasets. Figures more than 5% apart are flagged "Sources differ" and every figure stays visible.
about.estimate.curves: When no measured curve exists, the curve is borrowed from a sibling car with the same battery pack, or drawn from a template shaped by the car's peak charging power, battery chemistry and voltage class. Estimated curves are dashed on the chart.
about.estimate.wheels: Wheel-size estimates use official ratings that test the same car on two wheel sizes: about {pct}% more energy per km for each extra inch ({pairs} pairs).
about.estimate.wheelsNone: Wheel-size estimates need official ratings of the same car on two wheel sizes; none are loaded yet.
about.estimate.cost: Charging cost assumes the charger delivers about {eff}% of the energy it bills into the battery. Change the price to your station's.
about.estimate.derived: Charging times, km added and cost are calculated in your browser from the curve and battery; they are never stored as facts.
about.review: Automated imports and research only suggest data: a person checks every match and figure before it goes live.
about.dataIntro: Voltway is built on these open datasets. Their licences ask for the credits below.
about.ds.nrcan.name: NRCan Fuel Consumption Ratings (battery-electric vehicles)
about.ds.nrcan.use: Which cars are sold in Canada, with official range and energy use.
about.ds.openev.name: OpenEV Data
about.ds.openev.use: Battery size, charging power, ports, voltage class and other specifications.
about.ds.chargeprice.name: Open EV Data (Chargeprice archive)
about.ds.chargeprice.use: Charging curves for older models, simplified from Fastned's published charging charts. The dataset is archived and no longer updated.
about.others: Other figures come from {count} cited pages (carmaker pages, owner's manuals, reviews and tests). Each car lists its sources, with links and access dates, under Sources on the Charging tab.
about.noAffiliation: Voltway is not affiliated with any carmaker, charging network or data provider. Brand and model names belong to their owners.
about.problemText: Spotted a wrong or missing figure? Open an issue with the car and, if you can, a source:
about.code: The site and its data are public:
